name: HCB (The Hack Foundation)
summary: US charity that takes projects in as part of itself, with climate groups among them. Built for teenagers and selective about groups run by adults.

evidence.quote: If you are a teenager running a club, nonprofit, or robotics team, you qualify.

projects.value: Clubs, nonprofits and teams; climate groups are among those it hosts

evidence.quote: Climate-focused organizations using HCB to accelerate environmental action and sustainability initiatives.

gate.value: Mainly for teenagers; more selective with groups run by adults

evidence.quote: HCB primarily focuses on teen-led projects, so we're more selective with adult-run organizations.
